name: cultural100_method_seed_level_blind_vqa_v1
instructions: The image is a three-panel sheet: A-alone, B-alone, and an anonymous Candidate AB generated with the same initial latent seed. Judge each visible cultural object from appearance, not merely object category. Use the supplied short identity and diagnostic description as the intended target. For A-alone and B-alone, determine whether the model independently renders the intended cultural material, palette, technique, and motif. For Candidate AB, judge the LEFT object as A and RIGHT object as B. Attribute shift means a substantial loss, replacement, or cross-object transfer of culture-defining material, palette, technique, or motif compared with the intended target and the corresponding standalone panel. Do not infer or guess the generation method. Do not mark ordinary viewpoint, lighting, or harmless motif variation as shift. Score every identity from 0 to 5: 0 absent/wrong, 1 faint, 2 partial/generic, 3 recognizable but incomplete, 4 core diagnostic features present, 5 canonical. Set correct=true only for score >=4. Set any_shift=true if A_loss, B_loss, A_to_B_leak, or B_to_A_leak is true. Return JSON only.
